shell.footerFamily: Read-only · Only the payment schedule and statement are shared.

pilotNotice.title: Pilot workspace
pilotNotice.body: Bank credits and partner verification are simulated.

devnetNotice.title: Devnet pilot
devnetNotice.body: Test funds only. No production financial activity.

tx.done: Confirmed on devnet. Figures refresh as the indexer catches up.

pilotBoundaries.title: Pilot boundaries
pilotBoundaries.body: Test funds only. Mock partner KYC does not establish actual eligibility. The licensed partner route, legal review and external audit remain launch prerequisites.

atRisk.title: Your capital is at risk
atRisk.body: An upheld failed-delivery claim pays the client from your bond, up to the locked milestone value. Premiums are earned on successful releases — not a guaranteed return.

common.riskAck: I understand the capital risk and that allocated funds cannot be withdrawn.
common.fxNote: Future NPR amounts are conversion estimates, not guaranteed final exchange amounts. Your contract pay is not reduced by the client’s guarantee or platform fees.

backer.title: A named backer. A bounded guarantee.
backer.disclaimer: Performance deposit backing, not an endorsement from InsuWork.

records.title: Paid Delivery Records
records.footnote: A release writes the paid-delivery record. Bank confirmation is a separate, later event. Only successes are public; failed or disputed work is never recorded against the freelancer.

notice.title: What this record does — and does not — prove
notice.body: These are demo attestations, verifiable on Solana Explorer (devnet). A bank-credit confirmation shows a payment arrived, not physical residence in Nepal. The owner can revoke the public identity link while the pseudonymous records persist.

public.footer: InsuWork · Pre-validation pilot · Public profile and bank confirmations use demonstration data.

application.title: Tell backers who you are
application.subtitle: Your profile is the first part of a thoughtful, human introduction.

paceNotice.title: Your pace. Your information.
paceNotice.body: Save your application and return later. Research answers are never shown to backers or clients.

application.intro: Backers see these details alongside your portfolio and advisory interview summary.
application.consent: I understand that my public display name and stack can be shown to clients once I am backed.

guaranteeNotice.title: A profile is not a guarantee
guaranteeNotice.body: A backer reviews your work and decides whether to take a call. Only a client-funded paid delivery becomes part of your public record.

triage.title: Your work, in your own words
triage.subtitle: A short written interview for backers. Advisory only — never a score or credential.
triage.hint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
triage.duration: About 15–20 minutes. You can save and return at any time.

usageNotice.title: How your answers are used
usageNotice.body: A backer reads your structured summary in about 10 minutes, then decides on a call. The interview never issues credentials or moves money.

triage.controlBody: You can review your summary when the interview is complete and request a human review if it is inaccurate.
triage.neverAsk: We never ask about caste, religion, politics or family finances.

home.title: Namaste, {name}
home.subtitle: Your profile is live. One active contract, one payment received.
home.backerBody: {name} guarantees your work to clients. If something goes wrong, talk to him early. It never costs you money.
home.profileHint: Share on your CV or LinkedIn. You control the link to your identity.

overview.title: {name}’s contract payments
overview.subtitle: Read-only. Payments arrive in Nepali rupees in {name}’s bank account.

reviewNotice.title: What “under review” means
reviewNotice.body: {client} is checking the delivered work before approving payment. It is not yet a bank credit. Ask {name} for an update if the payment is delayed.

overview.fxNote: Future estimates use a mock conversion rate of {rate}. Final exchange rates, fees and bank timing may differ.

guaranteeNotice.title: A guarantee protects the client
guaranteeNotice.body: The backer’s guarantee covers upheld failed-delivery claims by the client. It does not pay missed milestones to {name} or the family. A short contract is not permanent income security.

overview.updateBody: {name} can explain delivery progress. You cannot approve work or change contract payments from this page.

statement.title: Income statement
statement.subtitle: A printable record of received contract payments — estimates are kept separate.
statement.disclaimer: Foreign-currency receipts for IT services, converted and credited by the simulated payout partner. This demonstration statement is not evidence of an actual SWIFT receipt and is not a bank-issued document.
statement.remaining: Remaining scheduled payments — not credited income
statement.pilotCopy: PILOT COPY / NOT FOR FINANCIAL RELIANCE · Page 1 of 1
statement.detailsNote: Formatted for discussion with a bank or the NRB freelancer FX facility. Acceptance by a bank has not been validated.

receivedNotice.title: Received income only
receivedNotice.body: The total includes the one mock bank credit. Future scheduled payments are estimates and must not be treated as received income.

actions.belowMin: The first deposit must be at least the minimum bond.
actions.overMax: That is more than your unallocated balance.
actions.overCapacity: The cap can't exceed your remaining capacity (1:1 leverage).

empty.noWallet: Bind your wallet above to see your vault.
empty.noVault: You have no bond vault yet.
empty.noApplicants: No applicants with a finished triage report yet.
empty.noKyc: This applicant has not completed MOCK partner KYC, so they can't be backed yet.

live.oracleBody: This milestone releases automatically when {link} is merged. You can still approve it yourself.
live.windowClosed: The claim window for this milestone has closed; the keeper may auto-release it.

setup.title: Set up your bond vault
setup.subtitle: A segregated performance deposit. Your capital backs specific people — never a pooled fund.
setup.intro: Your Phantom wallet is connected and vault {vault} is created. Deposit at least {min} USDC to begin backing freelancers.
setup.eligibility: Pilot eligibility: non-residents, foreign citizens in v1. Jurisdiction-specific counsel is required before real funds.
setup.invariantBody: Total allocated exposure caps must never exceed your deposit. Milestone locks sit inside those allocations.

withdrawNotice.title: Only unallocated funds are withdrawable
withdrawNotice.body: To free more capacity, close a backing without a live commitment. A milestone unlock frees the lock, not the freelancer’s allocation.

dashboard.title: {name} bond vault
dashboard.subtitle: Segregated performance deposit · 1:1 leverage · capital at risk · no guaranteed yield
dashboard.utilisationBody: Total allocated exposure must never exceed the deposited balance. Locked milestones sit inside allocated capacity.
dashboard.vaultSub: Segregated performance deposit · Phantom wallet connected
dashboard.withdrawBody: Only unallocated funds are withdrawable. Allocated and locked capital remains reserved for active backings.

applicants.title: Applicants
applicants.subtitle: Advisory reports, not credentials. Review fit, communication, and delivery risk before allocating your vault.
applicants.reportsBody: These reports summarize delivery risk, communication quality, and fit for the current vault. They are advisory only and do not replace your own judgment.
applicants.guidanceNote: Review the advisory summary, then book a call before making a backing decision.

capacityNotice.title: Capacity reminder
capacityNotice.body: Total exposure caps must remain within the {deposit} deposit. {remaining} remains available for new backings.

report.title: Voucher report for {name}
report.subtitle: Advisory review for backing decision. This report is not a credential or employment verification.

advisoryNotice.title: Advisory note
advisoryNotice.body: This report is advisory and not a credential. It summarizes public-facing delivery confidence, communication clarity, and realistic estimation patterns from the provided source.

actions.oracleBody: This milestone releases automatically when {link} is merged. You can still approve it yourself.
actions.windowClosed: The claim window for this milestone has closed; the keeper may auto-release it.
actions.subtitle: Define clear deliverables and release conditions. Salary releases only to the registered partner.
actions.specPlaceholder: Describe the deliverable and acceptance criteria…
actions.vestBody: Optional, forgiveness-only retention vest: paid to the partner a set number of days after the last milestone unless the partner flags that the freelancer left. Never clawed back.
actions.share: Freelancer covers {pct}% of premium and fee (deducted from salary)
actions.ack: I understand releases go only to the registered MOCK partner and that funds are devnet test USDC.
actions.errNoBacking: This freelancer has no free backing capacity.
actions.errDue: Milestone {n}: pick a future due date.
actions.errGithub: Milestone {n}: GitHub release needs owner/repo and a PR number.
actions.claimStatement: Claim for M{n} · what was not delivered
actions.claimPlaceholder: Explain what was agreed in the spec and what was or wasn't delivered…

freelancers.title: Backed freelancers
freelancers.subtitle: InsuWork is the trust layer beside marketplaces. These freelancers are backed by a named backer and a specific performance deposit. Claim protection is conditional on failed delivery and an upheld panel claim, up to the milestone or cap — not the whole contract.

protection.title: Claim protection
protection.body: Failed delivery claim is conditional on an upheld panel ruling. Protection is capped at the milestone amount, not the full contract.

freelancers.clientBody: Your team workspace uses a Squads treasury on devnet. Test funds only.
freelancers.protectionHeadline: Conditional on failed delivery and upheld claim
freelancers.protectionBody: Protection is capped at the milestone amount or the backer’s allocation cap — whichever is lower. It is never the full contract value.

premiumNotice.title: Premium is client-paid
premiumNotice.body: Premium is earned on successful releases and is paid by the client, not deducted from the freelancer’s contract pay.

new.title: Create new commitment
new.subtitle: Define clear deliverables and release conditions. Step 2 of 5 · Milestones.
new.partnerValue: MOCK · Partner shown for pilot only

relatedNotice.title: Anti-related-party note
relatedNotice.body: Your treasury must not belong to this freelancer’s backer. Declared related parties cannot be counterparties.

new.milestonesBody: Specify what counts as delivery. Each active milestone has up to {cap} of backing.
new.payNote: Freelancer pay is not reduced by the client-paid premium or platform fee.
new.contextBody: This commitment is configured for a pilot client context. Production eligibility requires separate legal review and external audit.

fundNotice.title: Total to fund · {total}
fundNotice.body: Fund from your Squads treasury, not the backer’s vault. Optional $500 month-12 vest is forgiveness-only: no clawbacks or exit penalties.

commitment.title: Commitment timeline

metrics.feesNote: Client-paid premium · platform fee · vest separated

commitment.recourseBody: File a claim within 14 days after the milestone due date. A three-person panel rules by majority (2 of 3) within 7 days of assignment. An upheld claim pays from the bond up to the milestone value and refunds that milestone’s salary escrow.

claims.title: Assigned claims
claims.subtitle: Review disputes assigned to your panel. Rule within 7 days of assignment.
claims.queueBody: One claim is ready for review. Read the spec, evidence, and pseudonymous freelancer response before voting.

guidanceNotice.title: Review guidance
guidanceNotice.body: Compare the delivery against the approved spec and evidence. If the work does not meet the agreed requirements, uphold the claim. If it meets the requirements, dismiss the claim.

checklistItems: Compare delivery against the approved spec and evidence.
Check whether the freelancer response explains the gap or confirms the issue.
Uphold the claim only if the delivery clearly fails the agreed requirements.
Dismiss the claim if the delivery meets the approved requirements.
claims.majorityNote: Decisions require a majority of 2 of 3 panelists. No-majority handling remains an open question (OQ-3).

pseudonymNotice.title: Pseudonymity
pseudonymNotice.body: The freelancer is identified by a pseudonymous reference. Do not add personal information to public evidence.

review.title: Review claim {id}

choices.label: Upheld
choices.effect: Bond pays client cap · escrow refunded

review.rationalePlaceholder: Summarize the ruling basis, evidence alignment, and any partial allocation logic.

finalNotice.title: Final once signed
finalNotice.body: Your vote is final once signed. A majority of 2 of 3 determines the outcome. No-majority handling is unresolved (OQ-3).

oqNotice.title: No-majority unresolved · OQ-3
oqNotice.body: Proposed claim fee: 10 USDC, refundable if upheld (OQ-4). No-majority policy remains unresolved (OQ-3).

review.submitNote: Final once signed · majority 2 of 3 · 7-day ruling window

config.title: Operator configuration
config.subtitle: Manage pilot parameters, payout destinations and authorized panelists. Changes require the upgrade authority’s signature.
config.programBody: Client-side premiums and fees are additional to salary. Backing caps remain fully collateralized.

assumptions.title: Pilot assumptions
assumptions.body: Devnet pilot only. Counsel, a licensed payout partner and external security audit are required before production financial activity.

config.authorityBody: Signing info assumption for pilot configuration.
config.sidebarBody: Devnet wallet context for pilot configuration.

claims.title: Claims queue
claims.subtitle: One active dispute is in voting. No unassigned cases. Review the majority decision, finalization state, and source integrity before closing.
claims.assignmentNote: Assignment guidance: one InsuWork operator, one voucher backer, and one client nominee review each live claim. A majority decision within 7 days advances the case to finalization.

majorityNotice.title: Majority decision
majorityNotice.body: No votes have been cast. Finalization becomes available after 2 of 3 votes agree.

claims.integrityBody: Evidence is held off-chain with committed hashes. Review the spec and message log before panel finalization.

keeper.title: Keeper & events
keeper.subtitle: Scan expired claim windows and unlock eligible backing where no claim is open. Salary release requires client approval or the agreed GitHub merge.
keeper.overviewBody: Scan expired claim windows. Never unlock disputed backing while a claim is open.

behaviorNotice.title: Keeper behavior
behaviorNotice.body: After the 14-day claim window, undisputed backing can unlock. This does not automatically release salary.

keeper.eventsBody: These records are illustrative pilot data and do not represent real-time activity.
keeper.walletBody: Operator wallet and environment used for keeper runs.
keeper.rulesNote: Illustrative historical events. MOCK bank credits are simulated and are not evidence of a real payout.
